description: PROP-006 and PROP-007 (verification-architecture.md lines 74-75) do not cover the failure mode described in FIND-005: neither test asserts WHAT post_url value the self-heal driver writes into its 'status:posted' ledger line, and PROP-007's synthetic new-format test case only exercises two DIFFERENT non-null URLs -- it never exercises a 'status:"posted"' line with post_url:null (the exact shape a count-only self-heal implementation would produce). As specified, a fully-compliant implementation could pass every listed proof obligation in this REV 4 verification architecture while still reintroducing count inflation via a null-post_url posted-line in monitor.sh's dedup set. This is a proof-obligation gap, not merely an implementation gap: the spec claims (verification-architecture.md Gate section, line 87) that Phase 3 adversary review 'confirms PROP-001..007 PASS' as the completeness bar for this feature's correctness -- but PROP-006/007 as written cannot catch the exact regression this feature exists to prevent (dedup count inflation) when it originates from the self-heal path specifically.

evidence.snippet: PROP-006 asserts only 'self-heal moves to posted/ + ledger line' -- no assertion on the ledger line's post_url field content.
PROP-007's synthetic new-format test: '1 status:"posted" line + 1 status:"unverified" line with DIFFERENT urls -> count == 1' -- no null-post_url posted-line case.
